content.value_statement: Azure W&B deployments require precise Resource Manager setup and marketplace details. This skill gives .NET teams focused guidance for instance lifecycle, SSO, regions, and W&B SDK integration.
actual_capabilities: Shows package installation for Azure.ResourceManager.WeightsAndBiases and Azure.Identity.
Provides workflows to create, retrieve, list, update, and delete W&B instances.
Explains SAML SSO configuration with Entra ID domains and enterprise app IDs.
Lists SDK model types, supported regions, marketplace offer details, and reference links.
Shows how to connect the W&B Python SDK after Azure resource creation.
limitations: It is documentation only and does not provision Azure resources automatically.
The SDK and API shown are preview versions and may change.
Users need valid Azure permissions, marketplace access, and tenant-specific values.
It does not replace deployment testing, cost review, or security approval.

use_cases.title: Plan a W&B Azure Deployment
use_cases.description: Use the skill to identify required packages, environment values, regions, and marketplace plan fields before implementation.

use_cases.title: Build .NET Resource Manager Workflows
use_cases.description: Follow the examples to create, read, update, list, and delete W&B instances from a .NET service or tool.

use_cases.title: Configure Enterprise Access Controls
use_cases.description: Use the SSO guidance to align W&B instances with Entra ID domains and enterprise application settings.

prompt_templates.title: Check Setup Requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: Using this skill, summarize the packages, Azure values, and permissions I need before managing a W&B instance in .NET.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Instance Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Using this skill, outline the steps to create an Azure W&B instance in East US with marketplace and admin user details.

prompt_templates.title: Add SSO Guidance
prompt_templates.prompt: Using this skill, explain how to update an existing Azure W&B instance for SAML SSO with Entra ID domains.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Production Rollout
prompt_templates.prompt: Using this skill, review my Azure W&B rollout plan for lifecycle operations, tagging, SSO, regions, and validation gaps.

output_examples.input: What should I prepare before creating an Azure W&B instance from .NET?
output: Install the Azure Resource Manager W&B package and Azure Identity package.
Confirm subscription, resource group, instance name, region, marketplace plan, and admin user details.
Use DefaultAzureCredential and verify the caller can deploy marketplace resources.

output_examples.input: How can I add enterprise SSO to an existing W&B instance?
output: Retrieve the current instance data from the target resource group.
Set the SAML SSO type, enable state, enterprise app ID, and allowed Entra ID domains.
Submit an update and verify provisioning state before sharing access with users.

output_examples.input: What operational details does the skill cover?
output_examples.output: It covers instance lifecycle actions, supported regions, marketplace identifiers, tagging guidance, error handling, and W&B SDK connection steps.

best_practices: Use DefaultAzureCredential with managed identity where possible.
Validate marketplace plan, region, and naming choices before deployment.
Configure SSO and tags during rollout to support access control and cost tracking.
anti_patterns: Do not hardcode real subscription IDs, admin emails, or tenant values in shared prompts.
Do not delete an instance without confirming data retention and owner approval.
Do not treat preview SDK examples as final production guidance without validation.

faq.question: Does this skill create Azure resources automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples for users who run their own .NET and Azure workflows.

faq.question: Which SDK does this skill focus on?
faq.answer: It focuses on Azure.ResourceManager.WeightsAndBiases for .NET with Azure.Identity authentication.

faq.question: Can it help with W&B experiment tracking?
faq.answer: It shows how to connect the W&B Python SDK after the Azure instance exists.

faq.question: Does it cover single sign-on?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes SAML SSO configuration fields for Entra ID domains and enterprise app IDs.

faq.question: Is the referenced SDK stable?
faq.answer: The skill references a preview SDK and preview API version, so users should verify current Azure documentation.

faq.question: What access do users need?
faq.answer: Users need Azure permissions for the target subscription, resource group, marketplace offer, and identity configuration.
